correctness.rationale: All-dimensional Dirichlet neutrality establishes a strictly decreasing conditional tail; exact covariance reduction and positive variance at equal thresholds yield existence and uniqueness of the sign crossing. Uniform-simplex translation and Taylor expansion establish the geometric corollary; 139672 exact arithmetic checks and independent seeded simulations corroborate.
